title: Long install names never block worker-pool growth, and a growth failure is shown until it recovers
description: An install named inspecthoa-hwd-backend whose registry allows 13 workers (13 accounts × concurrency 1) grows its worker pool to 13 schema-valid, stable, unique profiles within Herdr's 32-character session names, where base generated the 33-character inspecthoa-hwd-backend-claude-1-2 the schema refuses. An injected growth failure appears with its exact cause and the capacity it leaves in master status and on the dashboard's Needs you, stands through a further cycle, and clears once growth succeeds; configured profiles stay intact; master workers, master status and the dispatcher agree on 13, and headless dispatch with no Herdr session launches all 13.

steps.name: worker-pool growth under a long install name, its failure surfaced and cleared
